第2832章 皇宫集合（第1页）
林铭真有筑基期修为的时候，吴辰在他的面前就算不了什么了？！
他的那些朋友，就算是有什么问题？
在他看来，弄那些小动作就彻底没有作用了。
和林铭打了这么久的交道，吴辰对林铭也是有着一定的了解的。
他刚刚一说，也就仅仅是试探一下而已。
凭借他对林铭的了解，也知道林铭大概率都是会拒绝的。
现在林铭的拒绝，并没有让他感受到任何一点意外。
“贾大师，什么时候能够进入到宗门？！”
双方聊了一会，吴辰这才告辞离去。
等对方离开之后，林铭则在自己的房间之中，继续开始进行修炼！
自己现在大概率可以进入到符箓宗不假！
这并不意味着自己的修炼之路就已经是一帆风顺了！
也并不意味着自己就已经站在了修炼之路的了。
算是他真正踏入到了修仙者的大门而已！
他在修仙者的道路上，还要持续的走下去，甚至许多道路，依旧不可能是依靠宗门来帮助获得的，他想要获得，就还只能够依靠自己来完成！
每天都会有一些认识他的人来和他庆贺！
甚至筑基期的掌柜的都亲自来祝贺过林铭，也给林铭讲解了一些踏入到筑基期之后的注意事项以及一份礼物！

这礼物，对筑基期的他也并不算是什么？！
可对炼气期的林铭来说，就是不一样的了。
林铭的那份令牌才亮了起来，从中传来了一道声音。
林铭答应一声，不敢有任何迟疑，收起了自己房间之中的东西，立刻向着皇宫门口的方向而去。
只有符箓宗的弟子，以及其他获得临时许可的弟子才能够踏入到这里。
不然，其他修仙者是绝对不能够靠近这里。
现在也就是林铭即将加入到符箓宗内，才可以接近这里的。
一番行进，林铭就来到了皇宫的门前，有一队宫城甲士正在之前，见到林铭前来，这些人也第一时间迎了上来。
“贾大师，您来了？！里面已然是传下命令来，您来了之后，不必通传，直接随我们进去就好。”
将双方都放在了一个平等的位置上。
现代出身的他，从来都并不觉得大家有什么区别。

Chapter 2832 Gathering in the Royal Palace (Page 1)
When Lin Ming really reaches the foundation building stage, Wu Chen will be nothing in front of him? !
What's wrong with his friends?
In his opinion, those little tricks are completely useless.
Having dealt with Lin Ming for so long, Wu Chen also had a certain understanding of Lin Ming.
What he just said was just a test.
Based on his understanding of Lin Ming, he also knew that Lin Ming would most likely refuse.
Now Lin Ming's rejection did not surprise him at all.
"Master Jia, when can you enter the sect?!"
The two parties chatted for a while, and then Wu Chen said goodbye and left.
After the other party left, Lin Ming continued to practice in his room!
There is a high probability that I can enter Fulu Sect now!
This does not mean that your cultivation path has been smooth sailing!
It doesn't mean that you are already on the path of cultivation.
It was like he had truly stepped into the door of cultivating immortals!
He will continue to walk on the road of cultivating immortals. Even many roads cannot be obtained by relying on the help of the sect. If he wants to obtain them, he can only rely on himself to complete them!
Every day some people who knew him came to celebrate with him!
Even the shopkeeper of the Foundation Establishment Stage personally came to congratulate Lin Ming, and also explained some precautions and a gift to Lin Ming after entering the Foundation Establishment Stage!
This gift is nothing to him in the foundation building stage? !
But for Lin Ming in the Qi refining stage, it was different.
Lin Ming's token lit up, and a voice came from it.
Lin Ming agreed without any hesitation, put away the things in his room, and immediately headed towards the entrance of the palace.
Only disciples of the Fu Lu Sect and other disciples with temporary permission can enter here.
Otherwise, other immortal cultivators will never be able to get close to here.
Now that Lin Ming is about to join the Fu Lu Sect, he can get close to this place.
After marching, Lin Ming arrived in front of the palace. A group of palace soldiers were in front of them. When they saw Lin Ming approaching, these people immediately came to greet them.
"Master Jia, are you here?! The orders have already been passed down inside. When you come, there is no need to pass them on, just follow us in."
Put both parties on an equal footing.
Coming from a modern background, he never felt that there was any difference between people.
